|quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} {{about|the skill|the divination card|The Wrath}} '''Wrath''' casts an [[aura]] that grants additional [[lightning damage]] to the [[attack]]s of the caster and their [[Ally|allies]] and makes their [[spell]]s deal more lightning damage. ==Skill functions and interactions== The effect of this skill is considered a [[buff]], and will be affected by [[modifier]]s that affect buffs. Multiple Wrath auras from different allies do not stack. Only damage from highest-level aura affecting a creature will be added. For more information about auras in general, see [[aura]]. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Lightning Damage
with Attacks |c1_header = You and nearby allies deal x to y additional Lightning Damage with Attacks |c1_pattern_extract = You and nearby allies deal (%d+) to (%d+) additional Lightning Damage with Attacks |c1_pattern_value = %d to %d |c2_abbr = more
Lightning Damage
with Spells |c2_header = You and nearby allies deal x% more Spell Lightning Damage |c2_pattern_extract = You and nearby allies deal (%d+)%% more Spell Lightning Damage |c2_pattern_value = %d%% |c3_abbr = Radius |c3_header = +x metres to radius |c3_pattern_extract = %+(%d+%.*%d*) metres? to radius |c3_pattern_value = +%sm }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Ruthless mode== Wrath cannot be obtained from [[quest]]s or traded for using an {{il|Uncarved Gemstone}} through [[Siosa]] in [[Ruthless mode]]. {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} ==Related unique items== The following [[unique item]]s are related to Wrath: {{Drop enabled unique item table |where = items.stat_text LIKE "%Wrath%" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ==Related passive skills== The following [[passive skill]]s are related to Wrath: {{Query base passive skills |where=passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Wrath%" }} The following cluster jewel-only [[passive skill]]s are related to Wrath: {{Passive skill table |q_where=passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Wrath%" AND passive_skills.id LIKE "%affliction%" |large=1 |stat=1 }} ==Related modifiers== The following spawnable [[modifier]]s are related to Wrath:
{{Query spawnable modifiers |where=mod_stats.id LIKE "%wrath%" AND mods.generation_type NOT LIKE "10" |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 |domain=1 }}
These Synthesis implicit can be found on pre-[[synthesised item]]s or added via [[Harvest]] mechanics: {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%Wrath%" AND mods.id LIKE "%SynthesisImplicit%" |stat_text=1 |level=1 |domain=1 }} ===Legacy mods=== The following mods can only be found on legacy items in permanent leagues: {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%wrath%" AND mods.generation_type NOT LIKE "3" |q_having = SUM(mod_spawn_weights.value) = 0 |q_groupBy = mod_spawn_weights._pageID |stat_text=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 |domain=1 }} {{Alternate skill effect list|query= items.class_id="Microtransaction" AND cosmetic_items.cosmetic_type LIKE "Skill Gem Effect" AND ( BINARY items.name LIKE "%Wrath%" OR BINARY items.description LIKE "%Wrath%" OR items.description LIKE "%your aura%" OR BINARY items.name LIKE "Invisible Buff Effect" ) }} ==Monster version== [[File:MonsterAmarissaAuraAddedLightningDamage.png|thumb|right|[[Amarissa, Daughter of Merveil|Amarissa]] version of added lighting damage aura. Note that the surrounding monsters have a blue ball visual effect.]] The monster version of this aura, [[Lightning Damage Aura]], does not add flat lighting damage, but {{c|mod|Gain #% of Physical Damage as Extra Lightning Damage. }} Most of them have magnitude of 25%, and 150% variant is used by [[Humming Totem]] (mod id: MonsterAuraUniqueMapLightningDamage; {{il|The Putrid Cloister}}). [[Amarissa, Daughter of Merveil]] of Act 1 uses the variant "MonsterAmarissaAuraAddedLightningDamage" {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mods.mod_type="MonsterAuraAddedLightningDamage" AND domain = "3" AND mods.id != "StrIntMissionAuraAddedLightningDamage" |level=1 |generation_type =1 }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.4.0| * Now instant by default and can therefore be used while moving. * All instant skills now have cooldown 1 second or less. * Instant skills cannot be supported by Spell Echo and will not be cast a second time by similar effects (such as from the Echoing Shrine). }} {{Version history table row|2.0.0| * Grants X% more spell Lightning Damage. }} {{Version history table row|1.2.0| * We have reduced its damage at higher levels, from no change at level one to a 24% reduction in damage at level 20. }} {{Version history table row|1.0.0| * Base mana cost is now 60%. * Damage bonus granted by the aura has been doubled. * Base area of effect has been increased. * The area of effect bonus from quality has been doubled. }} {{Version history table row|0.10.0| * Base mana cost increased by 10 to 50, increasing by 6 per level instead of 5. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.8c| * Wrath now counts as a Lightning gem. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.7| * Wrath has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} {{Navbox Skills}} [[Category:Buffs]]
